entities.name: PMID:25092376
observations: Reports a BALB/cHeNhg-derived Rb1 promoter hexanucleotide deletion associated with reduced Rb1 activity and increased osteosarcoma susceptibility after alpha irradiation in mice.

entities.name: Reduced Rb1 promoter activity
observations: The variant promoter showed approximately 1.5-fold lower Rb1 expression in reporter and in-vivo expression assays; reduced Rb1 dosage was linked to significantly increased osteosarcoma incidence after alpha irradiation in mice.
Retrieved abstract did not provide group sizes, incidence percentages, or exact statistical values.

entities.name: Osteosarcoma
observations: The study assessed osteosarcoma incidence following alpha irradiation in mice carrying reduced Rb1 expression.
